name: Evelynn × Dota 2 Killstreaks Announcer
creator: dear-agony
description:
### Overview

This mod replaces League's announcer with original Evelynn and Coven Evelynn voice lines, combined with Dota 2 killstreak and multikill announcements.

Voice lines were adjusted and remapped to better fit League's announcer system.

---

### Evelynn & Coven Evelynn announcements

*(original League announcements → Evelynn & Coven Evelynn voice lines)*

**General**

• Welcome to Summoner's Rift → Hello, love.  
• 30 seconds to minions spawn → Enough foreplay!  
• Minions have spawned → This land will become a sea of torment.    

• Summoner disconnected → Awww, you thought you were getting lucky!  
• Summoner reconnected → Guess who's back for more?  

• Victory → Yes... Yes...! *(Coven)*   
• Defeat → So this... is... pain?

**Objectives**

• Your team destroyed a turret → Come on, let's see those tears.  
• Your team destroyed an inhibitor → Now, they will all know true pain.  

• Your turret destroyed → I hate it when they don't last.  
• Your inhibitor destroyed → They're all my favorites... until they break.  

• Your inhibitor respawn → Always leave them wanting more.  
• Your inhibitor respawning soon → You need to relax.  

• Enemy inhibitor respawn → So, they like it rough.  
• Enemy inhibitor respawning soon → This craving will soon be sated.  

**Combat**

• Ally slain → How unholy. / Dark blessings. *(Coven)*  
• Enemy slain → How bewitching. / Thy blood runs hot. / Thy heart is mine. *(Coven)*  

• You have slain an enemy → Ahh... this feeling! / Give me more! / Oh, yes! *(Coven)*  
• You have been slain → Goodbye, love. / No, no! Don't die yet!  

• Shutdown → Ugh... I thought you'd last longer. / That was fast.    
• Executed → Ooh la la!   
• Ace → Aw, playtime's over. / That was hot.  

---

### Dota 2 killstreak & multikill announcements

*(original League announcements → Dota 2 replacements)*

**Multikills**

• First Blood → First Blood!      
• Double Kill → Double Kill!      
• Triple Kill → Triple Kill!      
• Quadra Kill → Ultra Kill!      
• Penta Kill → Rampage!     

**Killstreaks**

• Killing Spree → Killing Spree!     
• Rampage → Mega Kill!      

*(Dota 2 Rampage was intentionally NOT used here because in Dota 2 it represents a Pentakill-equivalent killstreak rather than a regular streak tier.)*    

• Dominating → Dominating!      
• Unstoppable → Unstoppable!      
• Godlike → Godlike! / Monster Kill!      
• Legendary → Ownage! / Holy Shit! / Wicked Sick!
